description: Required fields for Newport terrain and prop assets. After G-4.18A/G-4.18B, crop-derived review assets are temporary_review_yellow unless their full source chain is proven green.
permanent_gate: Temporary yellow review art may be used to prototype composition, scale, and gameplay, but final-commercial Wayfarer art must come from green-origin assets with documented provenance. Yellow assets cannot be used as pixel sources for green final art.

review_source_policy.yellow_uncertain_newport_crops: allowed only for temporary_review_yellow prototype review art and never as source pixels for green final art
review_source_policy.green_origin_assets: allowed when generated from project scripts, authored parameters, and documented green/project-owned sources only
review_source_policy.deterministic_generated_assets: allowed when creation script, generated piece path, source inputs, and commercial status are documented

hard_rule: If placeholder is false and review_eligible is true, the asset must satisfy the Newport Visual Cohesion Rules and Asset Provenance gate: muted palette, dark outline or dark-side shading, internal material detail, contact shadow where seated, scale compatibility with building doors/windows/player, exact source documentation, no unsafe third-party or mystery pixels, and no silent promotion from temporary_review_yellow to green.
